descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S02 「养老院，UAT 第 1 步：查房前口述的任务出现在任务列表上」 Nursing Home, UAT step 1: tasks dictated in the pre-round appear on the task list

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th …（UAT TC-22 step 1；TFA-92588 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both（UAT TC-22 step 4；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh physician, Nursing Home resident from the fixture, no tasks

When Type the three UAT tasks into the Nursing Home pre-round notes and tap Save Note; open Post-Round → Tasks

Then Three open tasks: follow up BMP, PT eval, recheck weight in two weeks

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT step 4 applied to step 1 (and TFA-92588 AC 10): '3 pending tasks', not 'No tasks yet.' / '0 pending tasks'. Judged on the count only; the per-task regex waits for mustMatch in oracle.mjs and sits in pendingChecks, outside the checkpoint, so nothing is silently skipped (runnerGaps 1). On main the Nursing Home pre-round has no task call (see build), so a Fail is expected; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
